topics.title: The DNA: Structure of the Polynucleotide Chain and Double Helix

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the components of a nucleotide and the linkages that form a nucleoside, nucleotide and polynucleotide chain.
Explain the salient features of the Watson-Crick double helix, including base pairing, Chargaff's rule and helix dimensions.
Explain how negatively charged DNA is packaged with positively charged histones into nucleosomes and chromatin.
Distinguish euchromatin from heterochromatin and relate packaging to transcriptional activity.

topics.title: The Search for Genetic Material and the RNA World

concepts.learning_objective: Interpret the experiments of Griffith and of Avery, MacLeod and McCarty on the transforming principle.
Explain how Hershey and Chase used radioactive phosphorus and sulfur to prove that DNA is the genetic material.
Evaluate DNA and RNA against the criteria for a genetic material and explain why RNA is regarded as the first genetic material.
Interpret the Meselson and Stahl experiment as proof of semiconservative DNA replication.
Describe the roles of DNA polymerase, DNA ligase, the replication fork and the origin of replication.
Identify the promoter, structural gene, terminator, template strand and coding strand of a transcription unit.
Compare transcription in bacteria and eukaryotes, including the RNA polymerases and the sigma and rho factors.
Explain split genes and the splicing, capping and tailing of hnRNA.
State and apply the salient features of the genetic code.
Distinguish point mutations from frameshift insertion and deletion mutations and predict their effect.
Describe the structure and adapter role of tRNA.

topics.title: Translation and Regulation of Gene Expression

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the charging of tRNA and the initiation, elongation and termination of translation on the ribosome.
Explain the negative regulation of the lac operon by its repressor and inducer.

topics.title: Human Genome Project and DNA Fingerprinting

concepts.learning_objective: State the goals, methods and salient findings of the Human Genome Project.
Explain the steps and the polymorphism basis of DNA fingerprinting using VNTR probes.
